note: Ouray County (CO) zones unincorporated land in eight districts (Alpine, Colona, High Mesa, North Mesa, Public Lands, South Mesa plus overlays), but the official zoning map is a recorded map on file with the County Clerk (reception #173907). Published county zoning appears only as PDF text and a 2012 draft PDF reference map; the county's GIS page says it lacks resources for online mapping and the draft ArcGIS web map is a viewer with no zoning service found. The county's GIS open data (ourayrrca/csterling_oc parcel and boundary services) carries no zoning field. City of Ouray zoning is a 2021 PDF map; Town of Ridgway's zoning map (Aug 2025) is a PDF with no feature service found in search. No queryable zoning district polygon service was found.
